slides.title: Introduction
slides.content:
# PyTorch 🔥

Deep learning by Meta!

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(784, 128)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 10)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        x = torch.relu(self.fc1(x))
        return self.fc2(x)

model = Net()
```

> 💡 **Dynamic graphs** - more Pythonic!

slides.title: Training
slides.content:
# Training Loop 🔄

```python
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters())

for epoch in range(10):
    for data, target in loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        output = model(data)
        loss = criterion(output, target)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
```
